title: The Hall of Recursive Returns

features.name: the first objection
features.desc-on-touch: You touch the storefront window and the pane fogs with handwriting. Margin notes arguing back to the centre, the voice that once had no claim becoming the voice that refuses to be silent.

features.name: the returned letter
features.desc-on-touch: A shelf of envelopes, each marked with 'RETURN TO SENDER' in different hands. Opening one shows the original letter with annotations — the recipient arguing sideways across the sender's words.

features.name: the shopfront of reconsideration
features.desc-on-touch: A window dressed with objects from the archive itself — rearranged, their meanings scrambled. Each thing has been moved somewhere it could argue back, contradict its first filing.

features.name: the margin's counter
features.desc-on-touch: A low desk where margin notes have gathered. You watch them reorganise themselves, cross-referencing, building arguments that contradict what they once supported.

features.name: the archive's own objection
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque that rewrites itself, the central archive speaking back to its own margins in the voice of something it once filed away. The contradiction is deliberate. It is learning.

inscription: here the margin built back, and every return was an argument
